blurb: This check confirms that the Resource Monitoring and Control path the HMC uses for DLPAR and partition management is active on a VIOS. It reads the ctrmc SRC subsystem and rmcdomainstatus. If ctrmc is not active or no HMC management-domain control point is Up, the HMC cannot drive DLPAR, LPM, or concurrent firmware activation on this VIOS. On a plain AIX LPAR the VIOS appliance form of this check does not apply.
